decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=READ, dst=<path label 0:1>, src=/reply-ep } - the labelled request a TERMINUS dereferences to one of its OWN vertices (RFC-0027 7.2). The whole dst is the 7-byte label the terminus minted for the residual `/sensor/temp` in fwd/fwd-label-terminus-reply, presented back by the origin that received it.
decoded.note: 33 bytes against the 38 the string spelling costs. There is no name beside the label - a label REPLACES the bytes of the part it stands for (6.1) - so a host that cannot validate it has nothing to fall back to and answers tr::path::not_found (7.2, fwd/fwd-label-terminus-stale). Whether the label resolves to a link (a hop) or to a local vertex (this terminus) is a fact about the minting host's table, not about these bytes.
